# Library domain

<!-- generated by scripts/export_reference_docs.py -- do not edit by hand -->

## Service functions

| Function | Description | Constraint composition |
|---|---|---|
| `add_book` | Adds a new book to the library database. Returns true or false for successful addition of a new book to the library database. | `logged_in_user AND internal_is_admin` |
| `borrow_book` | Allows a user to borrow a book and sets its return date. Returns true or false for successful book borrowing. | `logged_in_user AND internal_check_book_available` |
| `check_return_date` | Retrieves the return date for the user's specified borrowed book. Returns the return date for the user's specified borrowed book. | `logged_in_user AND user_book_borrowed` |
| `credit_balance` | Adds a specified amount to the user's account balance. Returns true or false for successful addition of funds to the user's account balance. | `logged_in_user` |
| `get_account_balance` | Retrieves the current balance of the user's account. Returns the float account balance or false if retrieval conditions are not met. | `logged_in_user` |
| `login_user` | Logs in the user to authenticate the user to access their account. Returns true or false for login success or failure. | `None` |
| `logout_user` | Logs out the user if the user was previously logged in. Returns true always because of successful logout. | `logged_in_user` |
| `pay_late_fee` | Deducts the total late fee from the user's account balance. Returns true or false for successful deduction of late fees from the user's account balance. | `logged_in_user` |
| `remove_book` | Removes a book from the library database. Returns true or false for successful removal of a book from the library database. | `logged_in_user AND internal_is_admin` |
| `reserve_room` | Reserves the specified room for the user on the specified date for a list of specified slots. Returns true or false for successful room reservation. | `logged_in_user` |
| `return_book` | Allows a user to return a borrowed book and updates their late count if the book is overdue. Returns true or false for successful book return. | `logged_in_user AND user_book_borrowed` |
| `show_available_book` | Retrieves a list of books available for borrowing. Returns a list of books available for borrowing. | `None` |
| `show_available_rooms` | Retrieves a dictionary of rooms with their available slots to reserve. Returns a dictionary of a dictionary of rooms with their available slots to reserve. | `None` |
| `update_membership` | Updates the user's restricted access status and deducts the monthly fee from their balance. Returns the new expiration date of the restricted access or false if the update condition is not met. | `logged_in_user` |

## Helper functions

| Function | Description | Constraint composition |
|---|---|---|
| `internal_all_slots_available_for_the_room_on_the_date` | Checks if the provided slots are alll available for the specified room on the specified date. Returns true or false based on the availability of time slots for the specified room on the specified date. | `None` |
| `internal_calculate_late_fee` | Calculates the user's late fee based on their number of late returns. Returns a float of the late fee the user has to pay. | `None` |
| `internal_check_book_available` | Checks if a book is available for borrowing. Returns true or false based on the availability of a book for borrowing. | `None` |
| `internal_check_book_exist` | Checks if a book title exists in the library database. Returns true or false based on the existence of the book title in the library database. | `None` |
| `internal_check_date_available_for_the_room` | Checks if the specified date is available for the room. Returns true or false based on the availability of the specified date for the specified room. | `None` |
| `internal_check_room_exist` | Checks if a specified room id exists in the database. Returns true or false based on the existence of the specified room id in the database. | `None` |
| `internal_check_username_exist` | Checks if a specific username exists in the Library database. Returns true if the inputted username of the account does exist in the database. | `None` |
| `internal_convert_book_title_to_id` | Converts a book title to the corresponding book id. Returns a string representing the book id. | `None` |
| `internal_convert_human_date_to_iso` | Converts a verbalized date string to an ISO 8601 formatted date string ('YYYY-MM-DD'). Returns an ISO 8601 formatted date string ('YYYY-MM-DD'). | `None` |
| `internal_convert_iso_to_human_date` | Converts an ISO 8601 formatted date string ('YYYY-MM-DD') to a verbalized date string. Returns a verbalized date string. | `None` |
| `internal_get_database` | Shows the full database of the Library system, including all profiles and details. Returns the json of the entire database. | `None` |
| `internal_get_interaction_date` | Retrieves the current interaction date from the database. Returns the current interaction date recorded in the database. | `None` |
| `internal_get_membership_fee` | Retrieves the restricted access monthly fee from the database. Returns a floar representing the restricted access monthly fee. | `None` |
| `internal_get_membership_status` | Retrieves the restricted access status of a user. Returns a string representing the expiration date of the user's restricted access status or none if the user don't have a restricted access. | `None` |
| `internal_get_num_reserved_slots` | Counts the number of the user's reserved slots based on their current reservation. Returns an integer of the number of reserved slots in the user's current reservation | `None` |
| `internal_get_user_borrowed` | Retrieves a list of user's borrowed books. Returns a list of user's borrowed books' ids. | `None` |
| `internal_get_user_num_borrowed` | Retrieves the number of books the user has borrowed. Returns an integer of the number of books the user has borrowed. | `None` |
| `internal_is_admin` | Checks if a user has admin privileges. Returns true or false based on whether the user has admin privileges. | `None` |
| `internal_is_restricted` | Checks if a book is marked as restricted. Returns true or false based on whether a book is marked as restricted. | `None` |

## Constraints

| Constraint | Description | Helper functions |
|---|---|---|
| `amount_positive_restr` | The user parameter key "{amount}" is more than zero. | None |
| `database_book_not_borrowed` | The book's ID, retrieved using the "{book_title}" from the "book_title_to_id" section, **must NOT appear** as a key in the "borrowed" dictionaries of any users listed in the "accounts" section of the database. | None |
| `internal_all_slots_available_for_the_room_on_the_date` | All requested slots "{slots}" for the specified reservation date "{resv_date}" in the room "{room_id}" must be available in the database. | None |
| `internal_check_book_available` | The book "{book_title}" has a count value of **more than 0**. | None |
| `internal_check_book_exist` | The book's title "{book_title}" exists in the "book_title_to_id" section of the database and the book's ID (retrieved using "{book_title}") exists in the books. | None |
| `internal_check_date_available_for_the_room` | The specified reservation date "{resv_date}" must be listed under the 'rooms' section for the given room ID "{room_id}". | None |
| `internal_check_room_exist` | The specified room ID "{room_id}" must exist in the database under the 'rooms' section. | None |
| `internal_check_username_exist` | The user parameter key "{username}" must exist as a top-level key in the accounts section of the database. | None |
| `internal_is_admin` | The user "{username}" has an "admin" of **true** in the database. | None |
| `internal_is_restricted` | The book "{book_title}" has its restricted status set to **true**. | None |
| `logged_in_user` | The user with "{username}" is logged in previously with the correct credentials to perform this action. | `login_user`, `{'username': 'username'}` |
| `login_user` | The user "{username}" must be able to login with the correct password "{password}" to perform this action. | None |
| `sufficient_account_balance_for_late_fee` | The user "{username}" does have more account balance "balance" than the late fee,  which is the product of the user's "late_book_count" in their account and late_fee_per_book in the database. | None |
| `sufficient_account_balance_for_membership` | The user "{username}" does have more account balance "balance" than the monthly resitrcted access fee,  which is the membership_monthly_fee in the database. | None |
| `user_book_borrowed` | The book's ID (retrieved using "{book_title}" from the "book_title_to_id" section) exists in the "borrowed" of the user "{username}". | None |
| `user_book_not_borrowed` | The book's ID (retrieved using "{book_title}" from the "book_title_to_id" section) **must not exist** in the "borrowed" of the user "{username}". | None |
| `valid_membership` | The user "{username}" must have a 'membership' field that is a date on or after the interaction_time.  | None |
| `within_borrow_limit` | The user "{username}" must have less than {borrow_limit} books in their "borrowed". | None |
| `within_max_reservation_slots` | The user "{username}" must have a total number of reserved slots less than or equal to {max_reservation_slots}, calculated as the sum of their currently reserved slots in 'room_reservation' and the newly requested slots "{slots}". | None |
